title: 15-Bean Soup with Sausage

items: 2 Tbsp salt, for soaking, plus salt and pepper to taste
10 oz (1½ cups) 15-bean soup mix, flavor packet discarded, beans picked over and rinsed
12 oz hot or sweet Italian sausage
1 tsp minced fresh thyme or ¼ tsp dried
8 oz Swiss chard, stemmed and chopped

steps: Dissolve 2 Tbsp salt in 4 quarts water. Add the beans and soak at room temperature for 8–24 hours. Drain and rinse.
Heat 1 Tbsp oil in a pressure cooker over medium-high heat until just smoking. Brown the sausages on all sides, about 2 minutes, and transfer to a plate.
Heat the remaining 1 Tbsp oil over medium heat. Cook onion and carrot until softened, about 5 minutes. Stir in garlic and thyme and cook until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
Stir in broth, bay leaves and soaked beans, scraping the bottom of the pot. Return sausage and its juices to the pot.
Lock the lid and bring to high pressure over medium-high heat. Reduce heat to maintain high pressure and cook 25 minutes. Remove from heat and quick-release pressure; carefully remove the lid.

Discard bay leaves. Transfer sausage to a cutting board and slice ½ inch thick. Simmer the soup with the chard and tomato until the chard is tender, about 5 minutes. Stir in sausage, season with salt and pepper and serve.
